subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should Feishu multi-bot mention recognition proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another proven cross-app identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The bug is real, but the submitted identity source is contradicted by the API evidence and the chosen identity contract directly controls whether Feishu group messages are delivered or suppressed.

options.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the Feishu identity fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.

options.title: Supersede With Replacement
options.body: Keep this branch as investigation context and move the canonical fix to a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app identifiers without relying on unavailable bot union_id data.

options.title: Close UnionId Branch
options.body: If maintainers confirm bot union_id is unavailable for this workflow, close this stale PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a different strategy.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the Feishu identity fix on current main only after proving the stable field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering every mention admission path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and have already requested changes on the Feishu identity decision surface.
